# BCIP backend function inventory and snippet coverage

## Scope and method

This report was generated by parsing the current backend TypeScript source with the repository TypeScript compiler API. It covers 100 TypeScript source files and 334 named function declarations, function-valued variables, class methods/accessors, and constructors (including private helpers). Inline anonymous callbacks are summarized through route registrations and tests, not listed as independent functions. No .env files or secret values were read.

The listed return type is marked inferred when the source has no explicit annotation; this report does not guess an inferred type. Imports and Prisma delegate calls are summarized per file, since those dependencies are module-level rather than necessarily unique to each function. Review route guards and data ownership in source before reusing a function.

## Verified architecture summary

- Backend package: Express 5, strict TypeScript, Prisma Client 5, PostgreSQL, Zod 3, Node built-in test runner via `tsx --test`.
- Authentication: `jsonwebtoken` verification in `src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts`; user and tenant claims are checked against Prisma; Firebase auth is separate. Session cookies are HttpOnly. Auth DTOs use Zod. Password operations use bcrypt; no refresh-token behavior is generated.
- Authorization: `authMiddleware`, then `tenantMiddleware` when tenant context is required, then `requireRoles(...)`; plan feature gates use `requireBusinessFeature(...)`. Admin router applies `SUPER_ADMIN` globally.
- Validation: Zod DTOs and route-local schemas. Common complaint helper is `validate(data, schema)`; several controllers map `ZodError.issues` into `Errors.validation(..., { fields })`.
- Errors/responses: `AppError` and `Errors` in `src/utils/error.ts`; global `errorHandler` emits structured error JSON. Success responses are mostly `{ success: true, data, message? }`; auth also uses `ApiResponse.success`.
- Prisma: `src/config/database.ts` is the common service client. `src/config/prisma.client.ts` and `src/lib/prisma.ts` are additional client modules; complaint DDD adapter imports `src/config/prisma.client.ts`.
- Prisma models: `Tenant`, `User`, `BusinessTrial`, `BusinessPlan`, `BusinessSubscription`, `UsageRecord`, `SubscriptionHistory`, `Team`, `Department`, `BusinessOnboarding`, `BusinessInvitation`, `Customer`, `Complaint`, `ComplaintCategory`, `ComplaintAttachment`, `StatusHistory`, `CSATFeedback`, `AIProcessing`, `Notification`, `AuditLog`, `AccountDocument`, `CompanyPolicy`, `TenantSettings`, `Integration`, `SystemConfiguration`, `TenantMetrics`.
- Prisma enums: `Role`, `AccountType`, `ComplaintStatus`, `Priority`, `Sentiment`, `ComplaintSource`, `ResolutionType`, `AIProcessingType`, `AIProcessingStatus`, `NotificationType`, `DocumentStatus`, `IntegrationProvider`.
- Complaint listing uses tenant filters and capped pagination. The complaint status snippet delegates to the existing service, which checks tenant ownership before updating and records a `StatusHistory` entry.
- AI uses `AIService` and the Python FastAPI `/api/v1/analyze` endpoint. `AIService.predict` catches request failures and returns fallback heuristics with `wasProcessed: false`; preserve that distinction.
- Billing uses `BusinessPlan`, `BusinessSubscription`, `UsageRecord`, `SubscriptionHistory`, Stripe service functions, and development-only demo checkout. Trial access uses `BusinessTrial` and feature/limit resolution.
- Migration directories (13): `20260910185234_account_foundation`, `20261003220000_business_trial`, `20261004154402_init`, `20261004155908_init`, `20261005173500_add_tenant_billing_state`, `20261114120000_auth_email_business_verification`, `20261115000000_auth_password_reset`, `20261116000000_add_firebase_uid`, `20261117000000_business_workspace_onboarding`, `20261118000000_business_trial_plan`, `20261119000000_subscription_catalog_usage`, `20261120000000_enterprise_onboarding`, `20261121000000_business_registration_location`.
- Test files (18): `admin-business-verification.test.ts`, `app.test.ts`, `auth-integration.test.ts`, `auth-policy.test.ts`, `auth-registration.test.ts`, `auth-security.test.ts`, `authz-integration.test.ts`, `business-dashboard.test.ts`, `business-onboarding-validation.test.ts`, `business-plans.test.ts`, `business-trial-service.test.ts`, `business-trial.test.ts`, `email-service.test.ts`, `firebase-auth.middleware.test.ts`, `firebase-login.test.ts`, `firebase-registration.test.ts`, `submit-complaint.use-case.test.ts`, `usage.test.ts`.

## Route, schema, and test coverage mapping

- Public complaint operations in `src/routes/complaints.ts`: submission, tracking, portal discovery, and CSAT feedback. Protected business complaint endpoints apply auth, tenant, roles, and the complaint-management feature gate.
- Auth endpoints in `src/modules/accounts/auth.routes.ts`: registration, sign-in, Firebase/session upgrade, verification, password recovery, profile, onboarding, trial, and invitation flows. Sensitive public endpoints use rate limits.
- Admin endpoints in `src/modules/administration/admin.routes.ts`: dashboard, businesses, users, complaints, configuration, plans/subscriptions, and AI configuration under super-admin authorization.
- Billing endpoints in `src/modules/billing/billing.routes.ts` and `src/routes/api/auth/billing/*/route.ts`: plans, checkout, portal, subscription, usage/history, cancellation/resume, and Stripe webhook. Webhooks are registered before JSON parsing for raw-body signature verification.
- Analytics: `src/modules/analytics/analytics.routes.ts` mounts the business dashboard with tenant and plan checks.
- Zod schemas appear in account/auth DTOs, registration/onboarding DTOs, billing/admin controllers, complaint validators, dashboard query handling, and configuration controllers.
- Tests use `node:test`; integration tests start `createApp()` on an ephemeral port and use `fetch`.

## Snippet coverage report

The snippet library covers reusable patterns for controllers, auth routes, protected/public routes, authentication and role middleware order, tenant context, Zod validation, tenant-scoped complaint queries and mutations, transactions, complaint status/history, escalation, public tracking, CSAT, service calls, AI prediction and response suggestion, onboarding, invitations, trial/billing usage, demo checkout, uploads, verification email, audit logging, errors/responses, logging, health, API mounts, environment checks, and unit/HTTP tests. Prefixes and required imports/adjustments are documented in `BCIP-SNIPPETS-README.md`.

A snippet is not an exact replacement for every exported method. Exact business rules remain in source services/controllers and should be called rather than copied where a corresponding service exists.

## Confirmed gaps / do not scaffold as implemented

- No refresh-token or refresh-session model/flow was found.
- No soft-delete `deletedAt` field was found in the Prisma schema.
- No fine-grained permission middleware or permission contract was found; use existing `requireRoles` and plan-feature middleware.
- No `ComplaintResponse` model was found; do not create response CRUD snippets against it.
- No background worker or queue processor was found. Redis is configured as an environment setting/dependency but no worker implementation was located.
- `src/modules/notifications/notification.routes.ts` only exports an empty router.
- `src/utils/async-handler.ts` is empty. `src/middleware/error.middleware.ts` documents itself as dead duplicate code; active handler is `src/middleware/errorHandler.ts`.
- `src/test.ts` is empty and is not included in the test suite.
- Complaint deletion is not registered in the complaint API; the delete snippet is only a tenant-scoped Prisma pattern and needs explicit retention/audit review.
